spec_raw: Disabled styles for checkbox/radio/switch are inconsistent

spec_refined.title: Consistent disabled styles for checkbox, radio and switch
spec_refined.description: Disabled checkbox, radio and switch components render with inconsistent opacity/colors across themes. Define one disabled treatment (reduced opacity on the control and label, not-allowed cursor) and apply it consistently to all three components in all themes.
acceptance_criteria: Disabled checkbox, radio and switch use the same opacity value on control and label
Disabled controls show cursor: not-allowed on hover
Disabled controls do not respond to click or keyboard activation
Checked+disabled state renders the checked visual at disabled opacity for all three components
All existing tests for the three components pass
spec_refined.technical_notes: Cross-component change: three tailwind.ts files plus shared scss; a shared utility/token is the clean solution.
